question: The diameter of a wheel is 63 cm. What is the distance covered by the wheel by making 100 revolutions? [Use π = (22)/(7)]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Distance covered in 1 revolution = Circumference = π × d

Distance in 1 revolution = (22/7) × 63 = 22 × 9 = 198 cm

Distance covered in 100 revolutions = 100 × 198 = 19800 cm

Convert to meters (1 m = 100 cm): 19800 ÷ 100 = 198 m

**∴ The correct answer is 198 m.**
